product_metadata.title: Chef's Star Lemon Squeezer Stainless Steel Citrus Juicer - Large Fruit Squeezer for Drinks - Rust-proof Juice Press, Non-Slip Manual Hand Juicer, Ideal for Juicing Lemons, Limes, Small Oranges
features: Juicing Lemons Has Never Been Easier - Chef's Star kitchen lemon juicer works like magic to squeeze out every last drop of juice without seeds and with minimal effort, unlike other troublesome manual juicers

Ergonomically Designed For Comfort - Using our citrus squeezer is a piece of cake. It features ergonomic non-slip handles, so anyone can squeeze this lemon press, even those with smaller hands or a weaker grip

An Absolute Kitchen Must-Have - The ultimate in performance, our handheld juicer does the job smoothly, quickly, and efficiently making it essential for cooking, baking, and of course, margaritas and bar cocktails
A Safe Kitchen Tool For The Whole Family - There aren't many safe and easy to use kitchen tools for kids, but this lemon juice squeezer is one of them, making it a great housewarming gift for family

Perfect For Years Of Daily Use - Our lemon and lime squeezer is made from heavy-duty stainless steel that's durable and can handle hard squeezing. Dishwasher safe, our citrus juicer has a large bowl that measures 8.5 cm and a 23 cm handle
